source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Stop a fan. (WARNING: Use only a non-conductive, flexible object to stop the fan. Do not attempt to use any part of your body to stop the fan. )
2. Remove the obstruction from the fan and check fan status

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Fan information in sensor list and SEL of BMC should be correct when fan is jammed
2. Fan information in sensor list and SEL of BMC should be correct when fan is back to normal state

original_test_intent: Verify BMC sensor and SEL behavior during a temporary mechanical jam of a specified fan and after the obstruction is removed and the fan returns to normal.
original_method: A qualified operator uses only an approved non-conductive flexible object to stop the mapped fan for a bounded interval, releases it immediately after evidence collection, and automated monitoring records fan/thermal/sensor/SEL response and recovery.
manual_activity: A qualified person must position/remove the flexible obstruction on the correct physical fan and verify that it spins freely after release. An agent may collect BMC evidence but cannot perform or claim the mechanical action.
required_inputs: Target fan/zone and BMC sensor mapping
Approved non-conductive flexible obstruction tool and safe access method
Maximum jam duration plus expected sensor/RPM and SEL failure/normal states with timeouts
Temperature, redundancy and service abort limits, OOB recovery and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Never use a body part, conductive, rigid or sharp object to stop the fan.
Confirm the target can be stopped briefly without exceeding cooling redundancy/load limits.
Continuously monitor RPM, temperatures, vibration, alarms, host and OOB; remove the obstruction immediately on any limit.
Do not repeat the jam automatically; preserve first failure and inspect for damage before service return.
agent_execution_scope: Collect full baseline, jammed and released fan sensors, RPM, temperature, thresholds and SEL/events.
Time-correlate the operator's obstruction/release record with BMC transitions.
Verify telemetry returns to supplied normal limits and report facts without performing the physical action or verdict.
engineer_actions: Select the fan, tool, duration and safety thresholds.
Perform the physical obstruction and release and confirm mechanical recovery.
Review all failure/recovery evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No execution command is appropriate for the physical injection. Its reference to removing the fan is not source-preserving; only stop and release the obstruction.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the manual obstruction method and use complete platform-approved sensor/SEL queries continuously before, during and after it; no software fault substitute is proposed.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Non-conductive flexible obstruction, explicit no-body-part warning, jammed/restored states and both ten-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN BOUNDED PHYSICAL JAM WITH CONTINUOUS MONITORING
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an owner-approved fixture/tool and timer for the mapped fan while continuously capturing full RPM, thermals and SEL state, followed by a mechanical free-spin and telemetry recovery check.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact fan FRU/zone for which temporary obstruction is approved.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record fan FRU, chassis, BMC/CPLD and monitoring-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform fan service/safety and BMC sensor/event specifications.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit mapping, duration, abort and recovery evidence without replacing the jam action.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; fan removal or a software-injected fault is not treated as equivalent.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Fan map, tool, duration, event criteria and limits.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Mechanical obstruction can damage bearings/blades and may not be approved on every fan design.

project_override_considerations: A project may prohibit jamming and approve a distinct fault-injection method, but that deviation and different mechanical coverage must be explicit. It cannot silently claim the source obstruction was performed.
expected_evidence: Target fan/sensor map, approved tool/duration, failure/normal criteria and authorization
Timestamped operator obstruction/release record and physical recovery observation
Full jammed/restored RPM, temperature, threshold and SEL/event timeline
No damage/unresolved alarm, final cooling/host/OOB health and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria consistently define a temporary fan jam followed by obstruction removal and normal recovery.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target, tool, duration and limits can be supplied through a safe project procedure. The physical core makes the case MANUAL ONLY, not intrinsically blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with physical NO, but correct its fan-removal wording and require evidence during both jam and release states.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and retain its bounded-tool, thermal and recovery safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Preserves the exact source mechanism and separates operator action from automated telemetry and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents an unbounded or wrong failure mechanism and defines objective causal evidence for both failure detection and recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: The decisive stimulus is direct mechanical contact with a spinning fan, explicitly constrained by the source warning. That cannot be executed remotely or safely automated by a software agent, while the telemetry can only corroborate it. MANUAL ONLY is therefore required.

no_automatic_retry: Jam the approved fan once for the bounded interval. On any abnormality, release immediately, retain evidence and inspect/recover; do not repeat or substitute fan removal automatically.
